newBlockingFinding.explanation: The public amend command accepts one Markdown body input and no explicit kind/typed comment input or formal parse delimiter. The formal contract must reject substantive replacement text while accepting arbitrary aftercare note text as non-authoritative. Without a defined discriminator, identical request shape cannot be reliably assigned a correction or comment intent; implementation would need to invent a user-visible interface choice.
newBlockingFinding.expectedRevision: Define explicit machine-observable input kind (e.g. --kind presentation-only|unreviewed-comment or separate --comment with mutual exclusion) and schema/validation. presentation-only treats --body as full candidate and rejects substantive diffs; unreviewed-comment treats input only as an isolated comment, never a candidate replacement, with authoritative=false. Test same bytes under each explicit kind, invalid/missing kind, mutually conflicting inputs, and official query state not changed.
